neighborhoodCoverage.note: Neighborhood resolution layer. Names are verified, recognized neighborhoods; nothing is invented. Coverage is partial by design: Israel has no single authoritative nationwide neighborhood registry, so a street with no mapping stays fully searchable and is marked neighborhood:unresolved. The runtime layer additionally learns neighborhood names published on official government deal records.
